bullets.text: AI Readiness Assessment - **Sage** provides insights on how prepared businesses are to adopt AI technologies.
Criterion Acquisition Simplifies Payroll - **Sage** acquires **Criterion** to enhance cloud payroll and human capital management for mid-sized firms.
Guide to Making Tax Digital - **Sage** offers a free e-book detailing the new requirements for Income Tax under MTD.
New Leadership for Ecosystem Growth - **Sage** appoints Gretchen O’Hara to drive partner ecosystem and customer innovation.
